# inspeximus

> Tamper-evident long-term memory for AI agents with a zero-dependency Python core, plus an MCP server; signing needs the crypto extra. Correct a fact once and the old value stays retired; erase a person and prove it; show an auditor what the agent knew when it acted. The erasure proof covers this store only, not a vector index, prompt logs, or backups, and it is an integrity primitive, not a compliance certification.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/): what it is, the measured tables against mem0, Graphiti and Hindsight, install
- [EU AI Act and GDPR evidence](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/ai-act.html): Article 12 event logging, Article 19 retention, GDPR Article 17 erasure certificates, RFC 3161 timestamps with the eIDAS qualified check, the agent-audit-trail export
- [GDPR erasure](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/erasure.html): delete one person from an agent's memory by subject, dry-run the blast radius, and verify the erasure certificate offline with no private key; for authorship, pin the issuer's public key and witness the anchor; a real run, eight checks OK
- [Audit trail](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/audit-trail.html): what the agent knew when it acted; a signed ledger entry bound to the memory store, a retained transcript checked against it, and the draft-sharif-agent-audit-trail-04 export; a real run
- [Migrate from mem0](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/migrate-from-mem0.html): import a mem0 get_all() export with one command, one record per memory with the user as its subject and created_at as the event time, safe to run twice; the mem0-to-inspeximus API mapping and what the import cannot recover; a real run
- [Comparison](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/compare.html): does agent memory keep a correction; inspeximus 100%, Graphiti 86.7%, mem0 53.3% over 30 trials each, with the control
- [Claude Code](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/claude-code.html): persistent memory for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex and Cline in one config line
- [Quickstart](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/quickstart.html): running in under a minute
- [Transparency log](https://dancenitra.github.io/inspeximus/transparency/): the published log a reader verifies offline
